title: EUSKALDUO homework import, schemaVersion 1
description: Documentation of the import format. The server-side validator (api/src/Content/ImportValidator.php) is authoritative and additionally normalises Unicode (NFC), trims whitespace, rejects control characters and < >, and warns about duplicates.

kind.description: week (default): homework for one school week. topic: a category such as the months or animals; it has no weekStart, is listed under Categorías and never becomes the current week.

weekStart.description: Monday of the homework week (ISO date). May be null in an import; the admin assigns it during review. Required before publishing a week; ignored for a topic.

groups.description: Optional named sections. ordered=true means the entries of the group have a meaningful sequence (months, weekdays) and enables the ordering exercise.

entries.description: Vocabulary in its source order. The order is kept.

id.description: Optional stable id. Omit it and the server generates one.

imageHint.description: Editorial suggestion for a picture the admin may upload. Never shown to learners, never a URL.

group.description: Key of a group declared in groups.

needsReview.description: true when the source was unclear. Flagged sets cannot be published until a human clears the flag.

alternatives.description: Each accepted translation is a separate string. Do not join alternatives with commas.
